data.exclusive_end_offset_policy: retain and count separately; never discard or shift; architecture decision required before training

definition.onset_count_t: number of annotated onset instances exactly at sample t
definition.offset_count_t: number of annotated offset instances exactly at sample t

exact_anonymous_count.public_expansion: a count k emits k repeated events with fields type and position only

anonymous_count_window_512.definition: each boundary instance adds one to its type count on [position, position + 512), clipped to the sample supervision domain

anonymous_multiset_per_nonoverlapping_bl.definition: all repeated type-position events whose positions lie in one causal block [b, b + 512)

historical_v7_slot_binary_window_512.definition: six binary slot elements per type and sample
historical_v7_slot_binary_window_512.purpose: baseline density and weighted-loss comparison only

full_stream_metrics: tracks, frames, duration and raw note-boundary instances
exact count histogram and positive-position density
unique positions, simultaneous extra instances and maximum multiplicity
events hidden by a binary union while it is already positive
naive positive-delta recovery and exact causal-inverse roundtrip
nonoverlapping 512-block event-count histogram and capacity curve

loss_audit.anonymous_candidate_loss: categorical cross entropy over count classes 0 through observed maximum
loss_audit.historical_baseline_loss: elementwise binary cross entropy over six slots

integrity_requirements: generated validation members exactly equal the V7 metadata members
no player 05 annotation or audio member content is opened
raw exact-count sums equal all annotated boundary instances
sample-grid exact-count sums equal raw instances minus exclusive-end offsets
no slot, string, fret, pitch or channel appears in an anonymous target
the causal inverse reconstructs every sample-grid boundary instance exactly
all reported histograms reconcile with their declared domains

decision_rule.exact_count_is_structurally_admissible_o: all integrity requirements concerning exact counts and anonymity pass
decision_rule.anonymous_window_is_structurally_admissi: the causal inverse roundtrip is exact; naive rising-edge losses remain a separately reported decoder risk
decision_rule.binary_union_is_rejected_if: at least one boundary starts while the same-type union target is already positive
decision_rule.block_multiset_result: report the smallest query budget covering all observed blocks and instances, without selecting an architecture
decision_rule.sampler_distribution_shift_requires_rede: sampled nonzero density divided by full-stream nonzero density is below 0.5 or above 2.0

constant_output_pressure.below_0_55: the constant optimum favors no event at the historical decoder threshold
constant_output_pressure.at_or_above_0_55: the constant optimum favors an always-nonzero output at the historical decoder threshold
